narr: Thunderstorms were slow moving and allowed for heavy rainfall to cause flash flooding in Saint David and Arivaca, AZ where running washed flowed over roadways.
ev: Video on social media showed flash flooding occurring over roadway. A nearby rain gauge measured 0.27 inches of rainfall.
Report of 20-24 inches of standing water at HWY 286 near MM 23.
lsr: Delayed report. NWS Employee reports 2 feet of water crossing the roadway at highway 286 and mile marker 23.
Video of flash flooding near Saint David via social media.
